name: fptu-lost-found-system
description: FPTU Lost & Found web application with planned Progressive Web App support.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.test: npm run check:architecture && npm --workspace @lnfs/api-node run test && npm --workspace @lnfs/web run lint
scripts.build: npm --workspace @lnfs/api-node run build && npm --workspace @lnfs/web run build
